abstract: Liver and lung metastases in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) differ in timing, molecular features, and clinical course. We propose that these differences emerge through five interacting processes: pre-existing predisposition, anatomical delivery, premetastatic conditioning, organ-specific selection, and adaptive colonization. This narrative review integrates clinical observations with genetically engineered mouse models (GEMMs), lineage tracing, and functional perturbation to explain liver-lung divergence. The framework organizes organ preference around the states available before dissemination, the cells delivered to each organ, and their subsequent survival and growth. It connects each process to an experimental readout, allowing recurrent-site associations and causal mechanisms to inform a common biological question. GEMM studies reveal early dissemination, heterogeneous metastatic competence, polyclonal seeding, and changes in tumor-cell and stromal organization across metastatic lesion sizes. Genetic manipulation of epithelial adhesion and tissue-specific signaling further identifies distinct requirements for hepatic and pulmonary colonization. Complementary transplantation experiments demonstrate organ-dependent responses to SMAD4 restoration and PCSK9 perturbation. Together, these findings support a probabilistic interpretation in which the same tumor-cell program can confer different advantages according to the target organ and stage of progression. Clinical recurrence patterns provide a complementary view of this biology, with isolated pulmonary disease often associated with a more indolent course. By linking evidence to the process it measures, the framework identifies opportunities to reduce dissemination, disrupt organ conditioning, or inhibit established metastatic growth and guides the design of prospective studies of organ-specific risk and treatment response.
key_points_ko: 췌장관선암의 간 전이와 폐 전이는 시기, 분자적 특징, 임상 경과에서 차이가 있습니다.
사전 소견, 해부학적 전달, 전이 전 조절, 장기 특이적 선택, 적응적 군집화의 5가지 상호작용 과정을 통해 전이가 이루어집니다.
단독 폐 전이는 종종 더 완만한(indolent) 임상 경과와 연관성을 보입니다.
summary_ko: 이 논문은 췌장관선암(PDAC)의 간 전이와 폐 전이가 시기, 분자적 특징, 임상 경과에서 차이를 보이는 현상을 다룹니다. 기존 임상 관찰과 유전자 조작 마우스 모델(GEMM) 등을 통합하여 전이 성향을 설명하는 5단계 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이 프레임워크는 사전 소견, 해부학적 전달, 전이 전 조절, 장기 특이적 선택, 적응적 군집화 과정을 아우릅니다. 이를 통해 장기별 전이 차이를 이해하고 향후 연구 및 치료 반응 설계를 돕는 기틀을 마련했습니다.
title: Liver-Lung Organotropism in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Five-Stage Framework
